name: White City Shopping Center
summary: White City Shopping Center is a community-focused shopping destination in Shrewsbury, MA, offering a convenient mix of retail stores, boutique shops, and dining options along the Route 9 corridor. Located at the intersection of South Quinsigamond Avenue and Boston Turnpike, the center serves as a one-stop destination for daily shopping needs and family-friendly experiences.
demographics: White City Shopping Center serves the Shrewsbury, MA community and surrounding Worcester County suburbs, attracting middle to upper-middle income families and professionals. The trade area draws from established residential neighborhoods with a mix of homeowners and young families seeking convenient shopping for daily needs and dining options. Visitors typically include working professionals stopping for morning coffee at Dunkin', families running errands, and local residents looking for accessible retail without traveling to larger regional destinations. The center's location on Route 9, a major commercial corridor, also captures pass-through traffic from commuters and shoppers traveling between Worcester and the MetroWest region.
description: White City Shopping Center is a convenient neighborhood shopping destination located on Boston Post Road (Route 9) in Shrewsbury, Massachusetts, just east of the Route 9 corridor. This community-focused center offers a carefully curated mix of large retail stores, boutique shops, and family-friendly dining options that cater to the daily needs of local residents. Strategically positioned at the intersection of South Quinsigamond Avenue and Boston Turnpike, White City Shopping Center provides easy access for shoppers throughout the greater Worcester area. The center prides itself on being a one-stop destination where visitors can shop their favorite brands, discover new retailers, run daily errands, and unwind with quality dining experiences. With regular deals and promotions from merchants, community events throughout the year, and a relaxing atmosphere perfect for strolling, White City Shopping Center has become an integral part of the Shrewsbury community, offering both convenience and value to families and professionals alike.
